title: On-prem workload fidelity simulator + regression detection pipeline for p95 and tokens/sec
creator: Marisa Chen
description: Build a deterministic on-prem workload fidelity simulator and an automated regression detection pipeline that measures tokens/sec, p95 latency, and regression alerts against stored baselines for Private/VPC/on-prem customer environments. This ticket covers test scenario DSL, KV-cache warmup emulation, network shaping profiles, GPU/CPU throttling knobs, and the pipeline that runs nightly and after model/runtime changes to detect regressions with alerting to Slack and a regression dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can ingest a customer environment snapshot (topology + sample traces) and produce a deterministic workload replay with configurable randomness seeds
Measured metrics include per-route tokens/sec, end-to-end p50/p95/p99 latencies, GPU utilization, memory headroom, and KV cache hit rates
Baseline storage present: nightly runs persist metric snapshots to s3://redwood-benchmarks/private-baselines/<env>/<date> with schema version tag
Regression pipeline triggers alerts when p95 increases by >15% or tokens/sec drops by >10% compared to baseline over rolling 7-day median
Dashboard in Grafana shows historical baselines, latest run diff, and top-5 contributing traces for any regression
Simulator runs reproducibly on customer-like on-prem VMs without requiring external network access (air-gapped compatible)
steps: Design workload DSL and mapping from customer snapshot to simulator scenario (Marisa) - DESIGN DOC: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/On-Prem+Simulator+DSL
Implement trace importer and deterministic seed scheduling (Rafael) - branch: feat/sim-deterministic
Add KV-cache warmup stage that replays prefix tokens to populate caches before measurement window
Integrate tc/netem profiles for latency/jitter shaping and cgroups for CPU/GPU throttling
Wire metrics export to bench-metrics collector and nightly pipeline job (airflow job: private_bench_reconcile)
Create Grafana dashboard and alerting rule for regression detection (Grafana panel id: 3281)
Run 3 smoke runs on dedicated on-prem lab and validate deterministic runs with different seeds
notes: We deliberately separate warmup and measurement windows to avoid cold-cache noise inflating p95
Prototype used k6 for HTTP-level work but we need lower-level tokenized feeder to exercise KV cache; plan to reuse token-driver from ENG-54210
Air-gapped runs require local object storage fallback; use minio endpoint blueprint in repo infra/bench/minio-config.yaml
Consider adding lightweight sequence-level fuzzing later to capture model non-determinism impact on tokens/sec
Estimate assumes 2-week pairing between Rafael and Marisa for the importer and pipeline wiring
